thesis: The speaker defines being human as the unique ability to contribute to a knowledge loop by recording and sharing knowledge artifacts across time and space, a trait that will persist even in a future where machines participate in that loop. He explains that while machines may eventually match humans in task performance, humans will remain distinct due to the emergent phenomenon of qualia, which machines currently lack.
